messages.subject: Project Falcon - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to speak yesterday. We'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the proposed acquisition of Wren & Hartley (Project Falcon). Target is the premium pet-nutrition business up in Whalley - founders looking to exit. Can you send through an engagement letter and we'll get the NDA out to the sellers?

Gregory
Calderstone Capital Partners LLP

messages.subject: RE: Project Falcon - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Gregory,

Delighted to act. Engagement letter attached - James Osei will have day-to-day conduct, with Elena Marchetti supporting. Our fee estimate to completion is £185k-£240k plus VAT and disbursements.

We'll circulate a mutual NDA to the sellers' side today and start a diligence request list.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
